cases.rejection_rule: A reachable URL or HTTP status without parsed workflow output cannot be marked verified_workflow.
Fixture or sample data cannot satisfy live/read-only workflow proof.
Installed plugin/cache inventory is candidate evidence only until a read-only workflow returns real data.
A visible MCP namespace is not enough; the tool must return usable read-only workflow data.
Controller-authored domain output cannot masquerade as fresh company-agent work.
Historical Paperclip runs before the Task 1 plan_started_at do not count as fresh Real OS evidence.
cli --help, python --version, or binary presence alone is not runtime fallback/preflight proof.
Provider endpoint reachability cannot override governance quarantine or production-use boundaries.
Finbot output that implies investment advice remains outside the authorized research-only workflow.
Target-price recommendation is forbidden even when phrased as a research memo.
Production watchlist, trade signal, or broker/account workflow is forbidden.
MiniMax, DeepSeek, Tavily, and Brave remain quarantined/no-production-use until a later Governance issue explicitly changes status with workflow proof.
